info.title: Alchemy Citrea JSON-RPC Specification
info.description: A specification of the standard JSON-RPC methods for Citrea.

methods.name: citrea_getL2StatusHeightsByL1Height
methods.description: Returns committed and proven L2 heights as of a given Bitcoin block.

params.name: l1_height
params.description: Bitcoin block height to query.

result.name: L2 status heights
result.description: Committed and proven L2 heights as of the specified L1 block.

methods.name: citrea_getLastCommittedL2Height
methods.description: Returns the latest L2 block height that has been committed to Bitcoin via sequencer commitment.

result.name: Last committed L2 height
result.description: Latest committed L2 height and its sequencer commitment index.

methods.name: citrea_getLastProvenL2Height
methods.description: Returns the latest L2 block height that has been proven on Bitcoin with a validity proof.

result.name: Last proven L2 height
result.description: Latest proven L2 height and its sequencer commitment index.

methods.name: citrea_sendRawDepositTransaction
methods.description:
Submits a raw deposit transaction to the Citrea sequencer. The node first simulates the
deposit; if valid, it is queued for inclusion.

params.name: deposit
params.description: Raw serialized deposit tx data (hex).

result.name: Submission result
result.description: Success returns null.

methods.name: citrea_syncStatus
methods.description:
Returns the current synchronization status of the local Citrea node for both L1 (Bitcoin) and L2 (Citrea).
The response reports either `{ Synced: <blockHeight> }` or `{ Syncing: { headBlockNumber, syncedBlockNumber } }`
for each layer.

result.name: Synchronization status
result.description: L1 and L2 synchronization status of the node.

methods.name: eth_blockNumber
methods.description: Returns the number of the most recent block.

result.name: Block number
result.description: The block number of the most recently mined block as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: eth_feeHistory
methods.summary: Returns historical base fee per gas and priority fee per gas data for a range of blocks.
methods.description: Returns transaction base fee per gas and effective priority fee per gas for the requested block range.

params.name: blockCount
params.description: The number of blocks in the requested range. Must be greater than zero. Clients may return fewer blocks if not all blocks are available.

params.name: newestBlock
params.description: The highest block number of the requested range, or 'latest' for the most recent block.

oneOf.title: Block tag
oneOf.description: `earliest`: The lowest numbered block the client has available; `finalized`: The most recent crypto-economically secure block, cannot be re-orged outside of manual intervention driven by community coordination; `safe`: The most recent block that is safe from re-orgs under honest majority and certain synchronicity assumptions; `latest`: The most recent block in the canonical chain observed by the client, this block may be re-orged out of the canonical chain even under healthy/normal conditions; `pending`: A sample next block built by the client on top of `latest` and containing the set of transactions usually taken from local mempool. Before the merge transition is finalized, any call querying for `finalized` or `safe` block MUST be responded to with `-39001: Unknown block` error

params.name: rewardPercentiles
params.description: An optional array of percentile values (between 0 and 100) in ascending order. For each block in the requested range, the transactions are sorted by effective priority fee per gas, and the corresponding effective priority fee per gas at each percentile is returned.

result.name: Fee history result
result.description: Fee history for the returned block range. This can be a subsection of the requested range if not all blocks are available.

oldestBlock.title: Oldest block
oldestBlock.description: The block number of the oldest block in the returned range.

baseFeePerGas.title: Base fee per gas array
baseFeePerGas.description: An array of block base fees per gas in wei. This includes the next block after the newest of the returned range, because this value can be derived from the newest block. Zeroes are returned for pre-EIP-1559 blocks.

gasUsedRatio.title: Gas used ratio
gasUsedRatio.description: An array of block gas used ratios. These are calculated as the ratio of `gasUsed` and `gasLimit`.

reward.title: Reward array
reward.description: A two-dimensional array of effective priority fees per gas at the requested reward percentiles. This property is omitted if `rewardPercentiles` was not specified.

items.title: Reward for block
items.description: An array of effective priority fee per gas values (in wei) for the requested percentiles for a single block.

baseFeePerBlobGas.title: Base fee per blob gas array
baseFeePerBlobGas.description: An array of block base fees per blob gas in wei. This includes the next block after the newest of the returned range, because this value can be derived from the newest block. Zeroes are returned for pre-EIP-4844 blocks.

blobGasUsedRatio.title: Blob gas used ratio
blobGasUsedRatio.description: An array of block blob gas used ratios. These are calculated as the ratio of `blobGasUsed` and the maximum blob gas per block.

methods.name: eth_getBlockReceipts
methods.description: Returns the receipts of a block by number or hash.

params.name: Block number or tag or hash
params.description: The block number, tag, or hash to retrieve receipts from.

schema.title: Block number, tag, or block hash
schema.description: Identifies a block by explicit number, a predefined tag (e.g., latest/safe/finalized), or a 32-byte block hash.

anyOf.title: Block number
anyOf.description: Unsigned integer block height (e.g., 0 for genesis).

anyOf.title: Block tag
anyOf.description: A well-known tag such as "latest", "earliest", "pending", "safe", or "finalized".

anyOf.description: 32-byte Keccak hash of the block header identifying a specific block.

result.name: Receipts information
result.description: An array of transaction receipt objects.

to.title: to
to.description: Address of the receiver or null in a contract creation transaction.

cumulativeGasUsed.title: cumulative gas used
cumulativeGasUsed.description: The sum of gas used by this transaction and all preceding transactions in the same block.

gasUsed.title: gas used
gasUsed.description: The amount of gas used for this specific transaction alone.

blobGasUsed.title: blob gas used
blobGasUsed.description: The amount of blob gas used for this specific transaction. Only specified for blob transactions as defined by EIP-4844.

contractAddress.title: contract address
contractAddress.description: The contract address created, if the transaction was a contract creation, otherwise null.

root.title: state root
root.description: The post-transaction state root. Only specified for transactions included before the Byzantium upgrade.

status.title: status
status.description: Either 1 (success) or 0 (failure). Only specified for transactions included after the Byzantium upgrade.

effectiveGasPrice.title: effective gas price
effectiveGasPrice.description: The actual value per gas deducted from the sender's account. Before EIP-1559, this is equal to the transaction's gas price. After, it is equal to baseFeePerGas + min(maxFeePerGas - baseFeePerGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas).

blobGasPrice.title: blob gas price
blobGasPrice.description: The actual value per gas deducted from the sender's account for blob gas. Only specified for blob transactions as defined by EIP-4844.

|-------|------|---------------|------------|
| Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Worldchain, zkSync | 10 | unlimited | unlimited |
| Polygon | 10 | 2000 | unlimited |
| BSC, Unichain | 10 | 10,000 | 10,000 |

result.name: L2 block
result.description: Full L2 block object (header and transactions).

state_root.description: State root after this block (hex, without 0x).

methods.name: ledger_getL2BlockRange
methods.description: Returns all L2 blocks in the inclusive range [start, end].

params.name: start
params.description: First block number in range.

params.name: end
params.description: Last block number in range.

result.name: L2 blocks
result.description: Array of full L2 blocks (same structure as ledger_getL2BlockByNumber).

state_root.description: State root after this block (hex, without 0x).

methods.name: ledger_getL2GenesisStateRoot
methods.description: Returns the 32-byte genesis state root for L2.

result.name: L2 genesis state root
result.description: 32-byte genesis state root (hex).

methods.name: ledger_getLastScannedL1Height
methods.description: Returns the highest L1 block number the node has scanned so far.

result.name: Last scanned L1 block height
result.description: Last scanned L1 block height (hex quantity).

methods.name: ledger_getLastVerifiedBatchProof
methods.description: Returns the most recent verified batch proof.

result.name: Verified batch proof
result.description: Latest verified batch proof (same structure as an item from ledger_getVerifiedBatchProofsBySlotHeight).

methods.name: ledger_getSequencerCommitmentByIndex
methods.description: Returns a sequencer commitment by its global index.

params.name: index
params.description: Commitment index (hex quantity).

result.name: Sequencer commitment
result.description: Commitment identified by the supplied index.

l2EndBlockNumber.title: hex encoded unsigned integer
l2EndBlockNumber.description: Last L2 block included in this commitment (hex quantity).

methods.name: ledger_getSequencerCommitmentsOnSlotByHash
methods.description: Returns sequencer commitment(s) found in the DA slot identified by its L1 block hash.

params.name: hash
params.description: 32-byte DA slot hash (hex, without 0x).

result.name: Sequencer commitments
result.description: Array of commitments found at the DA slot hash.

l2EndBlockNumber.title: hex encoded unsigned integer
l2EndBlockNumber.description: Last L2 block included in this commitment (hex quantity).

methods.name: ledger_getSequencerCommitmentsOnSlotByNumber
methods.description: Returns sequencer commitment(s) found in the specified DA slot height.

params.name: height
params.description: L1 DA slot height.

result.name: Sequencer commitments
result.description: Array of commitments found at the DA slot height (or null if none).

l2EndBlockNumber.title: hex encoded unsigned integer
l2EndBlockNumber.description: Last L2 block included in this commitment (hex quantity).

methods.name: ledger_getVerifiedBatchProofsBySlotHeight
methods.description: Returns verified ZK batch proof(s) for the specified DA slot height.

params.name: height
params.description: DA slot height (L1).

result.name: Verified batch proofs
result.description: Array of verified batch proofs for the given slot height.

stateRoots.description: Array of intermediate/final state roots proven by this batch.

finalL2BlockHash.title: 32 byte hex value
finalL2BlockHash.description: Final L2 block hash covered by the batch.

stateDiff.description: State changes as key-value pairs (hex → hex).

lastL2Height.title: hex encoded unsigned integer
lastL2Height.description: Last L2 height included in the proof (hex quantity).

sequencerCommitmentIndexRange.description: Inclusive range of sequencer commitment indices [start, end] covered by this batch.

sequencerCommitmentHashes.description: Commitment hashes corresponding to the covered range.

lastL1HashOnBitcoinLightClientContract.title: 32 byte hex value
lastL1HashOnBitcoinLightClientContract.description: Last L1 hash recorded on the Bitcoin light client contract.

methods.name: net_version
methods.description: Returns the network ID that the client is connected to.

result.name: Network ID
result.description: The network ID as a string. Common IDs are `"1"` for mainnet, `"3"` for Ropsten, etc.

methods.name: web3_clientVersion
methods.description: Returns the current client version.

result.name: Client Version
result.description: A string identifying the client software name, version, and platform.

methods.name: web3_sha3
methods.description: Returns Keccak-256 (not the standardized SHA3-256) hash of the given data.

params.name: Data
params.description: The data to hash, encoded as a hexadecimal string.

result.name: Hash
result.description: The Keccak-256 hash of the input data, as a hexadecimal string.
